Use the unity_* MCP tools for all Unity operations — they handle queuing, retries, and agent identity automatically.  MULTI-INSTANCE: This MCP server supports multiple Unity Editor instances running simultaneously. On your first tool call, instances are auto-discovered. If multiple instances are found, you MUST ask the user which instance to work with and call unity_select_instance before proceeding. Use unity_list_instances to see all available instances at any time.
